summary: Backend-only verification of /api/v2/prospecting/listings kolo_seed filter + thumbnail_url field. All 4 pytest cases PASSED. Auth via dev_code flow worked. In current preview env, Supabase listings table returns 0 rows for tested sectors (source='scraping_in_progress'), so the filter passes vacuously — however code inspection of _read_supabase_listings (v2_router.py L1529-1606) confirms both the server-side Supabase filter (url=not.ilike.*kolo_seed*) AND defensive Python-side filter (drops kolo_seed + non-http URLs) are correctly implemented, and thumbnail_url is always present in the output dict.
action_items: Not a bug — but to strengthen future regression coverage, seed a small set of real (http) Supabase listing rows for sector 75001 in the preview env so the filter is exercised with non-empty data rather than vacuously.
Frontend and iOS native fixes (mesh gradient perf, StoreKit 2 redeem sheet) require manual iPhone testing — out of scope here.
critical_code_review_comments: v2_router.py _read_supabase_listings: filter logic is correct and defensive (double filter — server-side + Python side). thumbnail_url always emitted as string (empty fallback). Good.
Endpoint returns 200 with items=[] and source='scraping_in_progress' when Supabase table is empty — graceful, no 500s on empty/invalid sector. Confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration_61.py is idempotent and safe to re-run. It skips gracefully if quota-blocked (402/403). If Supabase gets real rows, the same tests will validate them non-vacuously. iOS StoreKit and mesh gradient perf need physical device testing.
